opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK non‑profit organisations for new projects, commissions, acquisitions, collections, conferences, publications and long‑term research; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for research and travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding new projects, commissions, acquisitions, conferences, publications, long‑term research and individual research and travel activities.
